notes.title: Summer 2025 Update
notes.content: [h1][/h1][list][*][p]6 New Tracks[/p][/*][*][p]Refined Car Setups[/p][/*][*][p]New Scenario System for saving your favorite race setups[/p][/*][*][p]Racing Line which also shows curvature[/p][/*][*][p]Monoclass Racing Mode - all cars have same specs[/p][/*][*][p]Last to First (L2F) Racing Mode - start at the back and race until first place[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic Balance of Power (BOP) - cars behind the leader are given more max torque, higher max RPM, and less drag[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Drafting[/p][/*][*][p]3 Tracks which allow driving on smooth circular walls ("Arc" tracks)[/p][/*][*][p]3-axis G-meter shows lateral & longitudinal as well as vertical G-forces[/p][/*][*][p]High downforce cars can drive upside down with realistic physics. Driving on the smooth Arcs feels like flying[/p][/*][*][p]Low downforce cars can briefly drive upside down using centrifugal force by doing a Barrel Roll[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic BOP will be adjusted shortly to integrate this new driving mode to keep races close[/p][/*][/list]
